input.task: Extract every line-item table from a batch of 40 scanned supplier invoices, delivered as image-only PDFs, into CSV rows with the page number each row came from.
input.firstTool: pdf_text_extract: returns the embedded text layer of a PDF as a single plain-text string per page. Does not perform OCR and returns empty output for scanned or image-only pages.
input.secondTool: document_ocr_tables: runs OCR on scanned or image-based PDFs and returns detected tables as structured rows, each with cell text, a table index, and the source page number.
